title: Evaluating Fairness of Machine Learning Models Under Uncertain and Incomplete Information
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith. Its analysis focuses on the statistical and methodological challenges of fairness evaluation with missing sensitive attributes, using gender and nationality as case studies.

measurement_description: The paper does not conduct benchmarks related to faith or religion. The focus is on a general methodology for evaluating fairness (specifically, the equal opportunity metric) when demographic information, such as gender or nationality, is incomplete or uncertain.
